gateway-arch.name: Gateway Arch
gateway-arch.price_text: Tram to the top ≈ $19 adult; grounds and museum free
gateway-arch.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–18:00; longer in summer — check on the day
gateway-arch.tip: Book the tram ride online ahead of time and arrive 30 minutes early for security.
gateway-arch.best: Morning for shorter lines; clear days for the view

st-louis-zoo.name: St. Louis Zoo
st-louis-zoo.price_text: Free admission; some attractions cost extra
st-louis-zoo.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00 — check on the day
st-louis-zoo.tip: Go early in the morning when animals are active and crowds are light.

cahokia-mounds.name: Cahokia Mounds
cahokia-mounds.price_text: Free; small suggested donation for the museum
cahokia-mounds.hours: Grounds daily dawn–dusk; museum hours vary — check on the day
cahokia-mounds.tip: Climb Monks Mound for the view and start at the museum to understand the site.

anheuser-busch-brewery.name: Anheuser-Busch Brewery
anheuser-busch-brewery.price_text: ≈ $10–20 depending on tour; free tour options exist
anheuser-busch-brewery.hours: Daily tours, roughly 10:00–17:00 — check on the day
anheuser-busch-brewery.tip: Book the tour online and bring ID; the free tour is short but the paid one includes tastings.

missouri-river.name: Missouri River
missouri-river.price_text: Free to view; riverboat cruises cost extra
missouri-river.tip: Walk the riverfront near the Arch or take a riverboat cruise for the best views.

st-louis-union-station.name: St. Louis Union Station
st-louis-union-station.price_text: Free to enter; attractions inside cost extra
st-louis-union-station.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–18:00 — check on the day
st-louis-union-station.tip: See the Grand Hall for free, then decide on the aquarium or Ferris wheel.

washu.name: Washington University in St. Louis
washu.tip: Stroll the Danforth campus and the nearby Loop for coffee and shops.

panera-bread.name: Panera Bread
panera-bread.hours: Daily, roughly 06:00–21:00 — check on the day
panera-bread.tip: A reliable quick lunch stop; the chain started in St. Louis.

incredible-pizza.name: St. Louis's Incredible Pizza Company
incredible-pizza.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–21:00 — check on the day
incredible-pizza.tip: Good for families with kids; the buffet plus arcade fills a rainy afternoon.

city-museum.name: City Museum
city-museum.hours: Varies by day, often Wed–Sun — check on the day
city-museum.tip: Wear closed shoes and be ready to climb; it is part playground, part art.

soulard-market.name: Soulard Farmers Market
soulard-market.price_text: Free to enter; pay per vendor
soulard-market.hours: Wed–Sat mornings, roughly 07:00–15:30 — check on the day
soulard-market.tip: Come Saturday morning for the fullest stalls and nearby bars.

citygarden.name: Citygarden
citygarden.tip: A free sculpture park with a splash fountain; good picnic stop near the Arch.

forest-park.name: Forest Park
forest-park.tip: Bigger than Central Park; rent a bike or walk to the museums inside it.

art-museum.name: Saint Louis Art Museum
art-museum.price_text: Free general admission; special exhibits cost extra
art-museum.tip: Free entry and a good rainy-day option inside Forest Park.

delmar-loop.name: Delmar Loop walk
delmar-loop.price_text: Free to walk; pay per shop or venue
delmar-loop.hours: Shops vary; liveliest in the evening
delmar-loop.tip: Walk the Loop for record shops, murals and the Walk of Fame stars.

riverboat-cruise.name: Gateway Arch riverboat cruise
riverboat-cruise.hours: Seasonal, roughly spring–fall — check on the day
riverboat-cruise.tip: A short river cruise gives the classic skyline view of the Arch.

bbq-stop.name: St. Louis-style BBQ lunch
bbq-stop.hours: Lunch and dinner; hours vary by spot
bbq-stop.tip: Try pork with the local sweet sauce; go early to beat the lunch line.

botanical-garden.name: Missouri Botanical Garden
botanical-garden.price_text: ≈ $12–16 adult; discounts for kids and seniors
botanical-garden.tip: The Climatron dome is good in any weather; spring is best for the gardens.

science-center.name: Saint Louis Science Center
science-center.price_text: Free general admission; planetarium and OMNIMAX cost extra
science-center.hours: Closed some weekdays — check on the day
science-center.tip: Free and very kid-friendly; the bridge over the highway is fun for kids.

ted-drews.name: Ted Drewes Frozen Custard
ted-drews.hours: Seasonal; open late in summer — check on the day
ted-drews.tip: Order a concrete; it is thick enough to hold upside down.

old-courthouse.name: Old Courthouse
old-courthouse.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00 — check on the day
old-courthouse.tip: See the Dred Scott case exhibits and the dome view before the Arch.

lafayette-square.name: Lafayette Square walk
lafayette-square.hours: Always open; cafes have their own hours
lafayette-square.tip: Victorian houses around a pretty park; pair it with a Soulard food stop.

brewery-tour-alt.name: Craft brewery tasting
brewery-tour-alt.hours: Afternoons and evenings — check on the day
brewery-tour-alt.tip: Small local breweries offer tastings; confirm hours before you go.

arch-grounds.name: Gateway Arch National Park grounds
arch-grounds.tip: Walk the paths to the river for the best free view of the Arch.
